name: Fellmounted Shadow King
description: The shade of a forgotten ruler, cursed to patrol the skies atop a winged eel in the service of an even greater evil.

abilities.name: Fellmount
abilities.description: While the Shadow King is on his mount, he gains a +2 bonus to his Difficulty. When the Shadow King takes Severe damage, he’s knocked from his mount. If the Shadow King is unmounted, his mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

abilities.name: Light and Shadow
abilities.description: The Shadow King has advantage on attack rolls while in shadow or darkness and disadvantage on attack rolls while in bright light.

abilities.name: Relic Hunter
abilities.description: The Shadow King has advantage on attack rolls against PCs who have magic weapons or armor equipped.

abilities.name: Hellsong
abilities.description: Spend 2 Fear to have the Shadow King’s mount unleash a spine-chilling screech that echoes over the battlefield. Each PC within Far range must make a Presence Reaction Roll (18). Targets who succeed must mark a Stress. Targets who fail must mark a Stress and lose a Hope. If a PC can’t lose a Hope, you gain 2 Fear.

abilities.name: Air Support
abilities.description: Three times per scene, you can spend a Fear to have an ally within Far range reroll a failed attack with advantage.
